description: Canonical machine-readable RFC conformance ledger. Design status and implementation status are independent axes; no single scalar status is used. Human-readable documentation is generated from this file by scripts/gen_rfc_ledger_docs.py — do not hand-maintain a second copy. A criterion with "excused": true is explicitly deferred with a recorded gap; the MNCS gate (mncs.family.rfc_status.v1) counts it as accounted-but-not-satisfied.

entries.title: Semantic Foundation
entries.implementation_scope: Semantic program model, validation, canonical identities, and fingerprints across crates/mncs-model.

acceptance_criteria.text: Versioned semantic program model with validation
Production hardening beyond the experimental envelope

gaps: Production hardening and soundness beyond the bounded experimental tranche remain open.
entries.notes: RFC header predates the split ledger and reads 'Implemented experimentally'; recorded here as design STABLE with experimental implementation.

entries.title: Contract and Evidence Model
entries.implementation_scope: Obligations, evidence manifests and receipts, verifier results, PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN discipline with UNKNOWN never promoted.

acceptance_criteria.text: Obligations generated by language constructs with stable identities
Identity-bound evidence with invalidation on dependency change
Method-scoped outcomes distinguishing proof, certificate, verifier result, observation, assumption

gaps: Full method taxonomy enforcement across every evidence producer; so far carried by verifier.rs authority classes plus the new proof kernel.
entries.notes: RFC header predates the split ledger and reads 'Implemented experimentally'.

entries.title: Verified Intermediate Representation
entries.implementation_scope: HIR, SSA, selected SSA, translation validators, proof-obligation survival into SSA; proof-preserving lowering is partial.

acceptance_criteria.text: HIR and verified SSA with validation
Proof obligations survive lowering without accidental loss
Proof-preserving lowering with explicit proof transport

gaps: Proof objects do not yet travel through HIR/SSA as first-class artifacts; obligations and certificates travel, kernel proofs attach at the SSA boundary (elision) and lowering boundary (certificate binding).

entries.title: Recursive Introspection and Refinement
entries.implementation_scope: Refinement model, candidate evaluation pipeline, semantic patches; self-transformation remains experimental.

acceptance_criteria.text: Semantic patch representation for recursive change

gaps: Closed-loop policy and proof-carrying promotion are future work.

entries.title: Machine-Intent Expressions and Verified Lowering Envelopes
entries.implementation_scope: Integer arithmetic intents, facts/requirements/obligations, lowering envelopes, evidence-gated nsw/nuw pilot, proof-bound certificates (RFC 0007 tranche).

acceptance_criteria.text: Explicit arithmetic intents with edge semantics
Facts, requirements, and obligations preserved through IR
Conservative backend promises gated by current evidence
Generalization beyond the constant-range nsw/nuw pilot

gaps: Memory, aliasing, alignment, and relaxation promises await their semantics (explicit roadmap item).

entries.title: Proof-Carrying Dependent Core
entries.implementation_scope: Tranche 0.2: genuine dependency over flat binder-edge buffers with explicit levels (Pi/Lam/App with capture-safe substitution by environment extension, beta and weak-head evaluation with fuel, structural defeq with rigid levels), dependent NatElim with motive application, propositional Eq with Refl/Cong, assumption declarations with usage accounting, dual checkers (MNCS-native mncs.core.proof_dep.v2 plus independent recursive reference) in exact differential agreement over a 15-case corpus on five backends, sealed artifacts with assumption-aware bindings. Full proof transport through every compiler stage, file-based ingestion, and erasure remain explicit gaps.

acceptance_criteria.text: Canonical proof-core representation with versioned terms
Explicit inspectable proof terms with canonical identities
Bounded explicit universe hierarchy without hidden impredicativity
Dependent function types beyond monomorphized generics
At least one inductive family with dependent reasoning (Nat)
Explicit propositional equality kept separate from other equalities
Deterministic checking to PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN that never promotes UNKNOWN
Obligation integration: compiler-generated obligation discharged by a proof term
Invalidation: changed inputs invalidate proof reuse
MNCS-native checker executing through real backend paths
Independent second checker with differential agreement
Valid, invalid, adversarial, and unresolved fixtures
Real compiler integration with explicit proof relationship
Execution through research bytecode and portable WASM (plus C11/LLVM/Cranelift)
No proof claim implemented through test success or backend agreement alone
Explicit trust boundary with untrusted generation
Proof-core stratification: total kernel versus effectful execution

gaps: 0007-G4 proof transport through backend/codegen stages and proof-discharge unresolved (minimum HIR/SSA/lowering path exists)
0007-G6 proof erasure semantics unimplemented
entries.notes: Design stays DRAFT (unresolved calculus choices per the RFC); implementation is a bounded experimental tranche, not the full RFC vision. C14 is satisfied for the minimum HIR/SSA/lowering integration scope plus file-based ingestion; full proof-discharge and backend-stage transport remain open. C16 stays partial: one remote Fabric worker verdict plus same-host mediation, no Windows verdict.

entries.title: Machine-Native I/O, Resource, Effect, and Event Semantics
entries.implementation_scope: Effects, capabilities, authority, and closure obligations; granted filesystem roots with canonical enumeration, bounded chunked reads, and generation mutation hints on the research path (explicit refusal elsewhere). General I/O beyond files, event push delivery, and time semantics remain absent.

acceptance_criteria.text: General I/O, resource, and event semantics

gaps: I/O and resource vocabularies beyond capabilities are not yet modeled.
entries.notes: Bounded append-only storage (host_write/blob_append, Profile 0.12) added alongside host_read/clock/crypto: explicit capability + --grant-write path, 64-byte-per-call bound, recorded host_write effects with appended-bytes digest, fail-closed without grants, explicit refusal on non-realizing backends. General I/O, networking, processes, and full storage semantics remain open.

entries.title: Machine-Native Memory, Reference, Provenance, and Storage Semantics
entries.implementation_scope: Narrow capability pilots (alignment, disjoint ranges); no general memory model.

acceptance_criteria.text: General memory, reference, and provenance semantics

gaps: General memory model explicitly missing per roadmap.

entries.title: Machine-Native Concurrency, Causality, Atomicity, and Memory Consistency Semantics
entries.implementation_scope: Deterministic task-scope/channel contracts in stdlib (spawn/join ownership, id-ordered merge, failure-vs-cancellation, close-once channels, backpressure as data) plus the mncs-embed TaskScope runtime realization (bounded threads, deterministic merge, cooperative cancellation, failure aggregation). No source-thread execution, no blocking transport, no scheduler/fairness properties; memory-consistency model still absent.
gaps: Entire RFC vision unimplemented; blocked on memory semantics (0009).
entries.notes: Survey-level classification; deepen if concurrency work lands.

entries.title: Machine-Native Failure, Recovery, Nondeterminism, and External Observation Semantics
entries.implementation_scope: Failure-mode vocabulary, isolated failure semantics, runtime-failure classification across backends; failure-vs-cancellation distinction in scope contracts and embed failure aggregation. Recovery, nondeterminism, and external-observation semantics remain absent.

acceptance_criteria.text: Runtime-failure classification (division by zero, MIN/-1) on executables

gaps: Recovery and nondeterminism models remain future work.

entries.title: Machine-Native Executable Semantic Core
entries.implementation_scope: Reference executors, research bytecode, portable WASM, C11, LLVM, Cranelift over the declared envelope; artifact-only RISC-V/eBPF/PTX.

acceptance_criteria.text: Five executable backend adapters with bounded agreement

gaps: General memory/layout and unrestricted loops explicitly missing per roadmap.
pressure_sources: RFC 0007 tranche (kernel execution on all five backends)

entries.title: Machine-Native Abstraction, Polymorphism, Interface, and Evidence Semantics
entries.implementation_scope: Track 1 explicit universal abstraction: Profile 0.10 function-level type/Nat parameters with deterministic monomorphization. Remaining tracks are design.

acceptance_criteria.text: Explicit type/Nat parameters with deterministic specialization
Cross-module generic resolution with nominal identities
Remaining abstraction tracks (interfaces, evidence passing, higher kinds)

gaps: Higher-kinded parameters refused (MNE229); implicit evidence and traits are future tracks. Explicitly not parametricity or coherence proofs.
entries.notes: RFC header notes Track 1 and Track 12 explicitly; other tracks remain design.

entries.title: Machine-Native Module, Component, Linking, Dependency, and Compatibility Semantics

acceptance_criteria.text: Namespace imports with aliasing and identity preservation

gaps: Component-level versioning and compatibility negotiation remain future work.

acceptance_criteria.text: Executable versus external adapter distinction with honest notes

gaps: Unsafe operations do not yet generate proof obligations; RFC 0007 names this as future pressure.

entries.title: Machine-Native Staging, Metaprogramming, Introspection, Specialization, and Self-Transformation Semantics
entries.implementation_scope: Deterministic generic specialization/monomorphization with provenance; general staging and metaprogramming are design.
gaps: Staging and metaprogramming beyond monomorphization are unimplemented.

acceptance_criteria.text: Backend capability manifests and execution policies

entries.title: Machine-Native Assurance Profiles, Evidence Algebra, Trust Policy, and Witness Semantics
entries.implementation_scope: Status lattice, evidence combination, family coherence verdicts, promotion gates; assurance profiles are policy-level.

Promotion gates refusing on unresolved UNKNOWN
Full assurance profiles with witness semantics

entries.title: Machine-Native Value, Data, Type, and Representation Semantics
entries.implementation_scope: Records, payload-bearing finite types, bounded sequences, views, bytes, vectors, masks, canonical composite cells across five backends.

acceptance_criteria.text: Composite values with canonical cells on all executable backends
Bounded sequences, views, bytes, vectors, masks
Record equality semantics and nested-record CRE coverage

entries.title: Machine-Native Identity, Equality, Equivalence, Refinement, Substitutability, and Compatibility Semantics

acceptance_criteria.text: Explicit propositional equality in the proof core
Equivalence, refinement, and substitutability relations kept distinct

gaps: Definitional/propositional/refinement equalities are now separated by construction in the kernel, but the general RFC 0020 relation lattice is future work.
